name: My Sister Becomes a Demon Sometimes...?!
source:
Will is a 16yo boy who comes home to discover he will spend a weekend with his sister, who moved away due to a conflict with their parents.  During that time, he notices his sister isn't in the best mood...

[From [url=https://venus-lair.itch.io/my-sister-becomes-a-demon-sometimes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
16岁的威尔回到家，发现自己将与姐姐共度一个周末。姐姐此前因为与父母发生冲突而搬了出去。在这段相处的时光里，他注意到姐姐的心情似乎不太好……

[摘自[url=https://venus-lair.itch.io/my-sister-becomes-a-demon-sometimes]Itch.io[/url]]
